results.answer:
您的要求：

这些房源符合的部分：

results.answer:
不是。月租不超过3000新币是必须满足的门槛，用来先筛掉超预算的房子；在预算内的房源之间，实际用于排序的是离南洋理工大学的直线距离，越近越靠前，所以租金低并不等于排得前。

比如排在第一的941 Jurong West Street 91记录月租1900新币，比后面几套1600新币的还贵一些，但它到南洋理工大学的直线距离约850米，比Garden Court 那几套的约1600米更近，因此排在前面。

另外几套还缺到南洋理工大学的距离资料，暂时无法比较远近，就按原有顺序展示，不能据此说它们更差或更好。

注意：还不能确认这几套房源全部符合您的要求，附近MRT或公交的情况也还没有资料；记录的价格和现在是否仍可租需要联系确认。

results.answer:
Your requirements:
• Rent no more than S$3,000 per month (must meet).
• Within 5km of Nanyang Technological University by straight-line distance (must meet), and preferably closer.
• Ideally rent at or below S$1,800 per month.

What fits:
• Both homes are within the S$3,000 budget and the 5km limit.
• Garden Court is recorded at S$1,600 per month and 1,600m from the university, so it also meets the preferred S$1,800 rent level.
• Willow Residence is recorded at S$1,900 per month and 850m from the university; it is closer but above the preferred rent level.

Why this order: the two preferences are weighed together. Garden Court is cheaper and meets the preferred rent level but is farther; Willow Residence is closer but costs S$100 more than the preferred level. The combined result places Garden Court first, so the order is not based on distance alone, and neither home is ahead on every preference.

Note: recorded prices and availability do not confirm that either home is currently available; please check the current rent and availability with the agent.
